text: Thelma, a lonely young woman raised by strict, ultra-religious parents, moves to Oslo for university and begins to suffer seizures. When [she falls for a fellow student, Anja|trigger|love and desire], her guilt and longing set loose [a power she cannot control|rules|it has unnatural powers], and during a brain scan Anja vanishes into empty space. Back home, Thelma remembers [a baby brother found trapped beneath the ice of a frozen lake|wrong|loss that won't heal], and her parents tell her the power was [inherited from her grandmother|origin|family blood and inheritance], who is kept sedated in a nursing home.
